Alex Yoong raced for Minardi in 2001 and 2002. His teammates were Fernando Alonso and Tarso Marques in 2001, and Anthony Davidson and Mark Webber in 2002.

Of these, only Fernando Alonso won a drivers' championship in 2000–2025 (2005 and 2006, per the champions list). Tarso Marques, Anthony Davidson and Mark Webber do not appear as drivers' champions in that period.

ANSWER: Fernando Alonso
